steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Roman legend traced Rome's origins to Aeneas (Trojan refugee) and the founding by Romulus and Remus (753 BC) | Key Fact: The seven kings ruled Rome from its founding until the overthrow of Tarquin the Proud (Superbus) in 509 BC | Key Fact: The last king, Tarquin Superbus, was a tyrant whose son Sextus raped Lucretia, triggering the rebellion led by Brutus | Key Fact: The Republic (res publica = 'public thing') replaced the monarchy: power was held by elected magistrates and the Senate
